subsystem: API19 BitmapFactory resource decoding on iphoneos
observed_discontinuity: The identity-matched Frozen Bubble device trace reaches the first GameThread.scaleFrom and receives a null source Bitmap. The original APK's first decoded background is a JPEG. The device executable's build inputs contain only the PNG Skia decoder, while Linux and Simulator include JPEG and GIF decoders.
required_semantics: An original APK JPEG or GIF resource decodable on API19 must not become null solely because the iOS device host omits that image codec.
The same host BitmapFactory decoder surface is compiled and linked into Simulator and iphoneos builds.
A failed decode still follows API19 null/exception behavior; no game-specific fallback image is created.

differences.description: The previous iphoneos link inputs omitted SkJpegUtility, SkJPEGImageDecoder, SkGIFImageDecoder and their libjpeg/giflib objects. SkImageDecoder::Factory can therefore only select PNG in that executable. The shared iOS codec build and identical Skia decoder source lists remove that device-only omission.
differences.relevance: The unchanged APK stores the first decodeResource result in mBackgroundOrig and immediately scales it when the display is 1080x2340. That resource is res/drawable/background.jpg.

earliest_evidenced_divergence: Device build lacked a JPEG decoder before the APK's first BitmapFactory.decodeResource(background.jpg); the earlier physical trace cannot directly observe that return value, but its first scaleFrom receives null and the exact DEX/data/build path explains why.

evidence.artifact: Desktop AGR legacy run 00012ea72cdb18b80000cdd96ab359b3, commit 3dc5fb0, APK SHA-256 57f4735297befc68c0a7aa6cd9e442ecd250b1b2b38104324a12b6c2d4e18569: seq 165 decodeResource first call, seq 292 first scaleFrom, seq 298 fail=NPE;src=0, seq 304 surfaceChanged throw; draw 0.

Original APK GameThread.<init> DEX pc 161 decodeResource for 0x7f020001, pc 168 mBackgroundOrig store; resizeBitmaps pc 0-4 reads mBackgroundOrig for first scaleFrom. APK ZIP background.jpg has JPEG signature. Pinned Skia FactoryDefault/FactoryRegistrar selects only compiled registrars.

Existing Linux agr-bitmap-draw-host decodes background.jpg and GIF; existing Simulator first-content-frame evidence decodes/draws background.jpg. The new iOS source-parity contract asserts JPEG/GIF source and object inclusion in both host builds.

remaining_uncertainty: New iphoneos binary has not yet been built by GitHub Actions or run on the physical device; repaired device first-content-frame remains UNVERIFIED.
Earlier GUEST_METHOD_EXIT records lack return-value identity; new passive Bitmap witnesses must confirm the device decode result and full field/reference chain.
The older Simulator 1080x2340 result predates the exact current candidate; exact-commit differential is pending.
next_action: Run Linux source/bitmap contracts, exact-candidate 1080x2340 Simulator and iphoneos build; then run the new binary on the device and compare identity-validated decode/field/scale/draw/post witnesses without modifying the APK.
host_adaptation: The existing KitKat SkImageDecoder source and host libjpeg/giflib ports are reused. Only the iOS build target/codec link inputs are unified; BitmapFactory/DEX/Canvas semantics are unchanged.
